title: wb migrate reads an already-rendered inbox view as hand-authored and refuses on Intent's own footer
body:
`intent wb migrate` reads a file that Intent itself already rendered as a hand-authored one. On an inbox it refuses the carry on Intent's own footer; on a board it carries that footer into the model as items.

Found by cc on 2026-09-17 in the all-estate trawl's first pass, on a scratch clone of Courses. Courses registered `hv` at its cutover (`50ec2ed`) without carrying the board, so every file under `hv/` is already a rendered view: `wip.md` is an empty board of `_(none)_` sections, each of the three inboxes is the routing header and the empty sentinel, and all four end in the footer every generated view carries (`---` and `_Generated by Intent v3.0.3 from the whiteboard model ..._`).

- THE INBOX HALF. Migrate names the two footer lines of each inbox as uncarried units (`above the first ## (...) entry ... this line belongs to no message`) and refuses the node on six units nobody wrote.
- THE BOARD HALF, which the first pass could not show because the inbox refusal came first. Driven by cc on a fresh clone with `--drop-uncarried`: the board's own footer is CARRIED, as two coerced decisions (`carried: [decision] intent/whiteboard/hv/wip.md:34 -- ---` and `:36 -- _Generated by Intent v3.0.3 ...`), beside the six inbox lines dropped. So a rendered board puts the renderer's words into the model as a node's decisions.

This body first said that a drop "carried the board's two items". That sentence was wrong: the two items were the footer. It is corrected here, forward, and the defect is wider than the first body said.

What is wanted: one predicate in the renderer's own home (views.rs, beside the banner the renderer writes) that says whether a text is a rendered view, asked by migrate of every file it reads, board and inboxes alike. A rendered file offers nothing: no item, no message, no uncarried unit, and no pre-migration snapshot of generated bytes. The report names each such file on a `rendered:` line, so the skip is said and never silent. A node whose board and inboxes are all rendered carries nothing, says why, and exits 0. One arm: a registered node whose `wip.md` and inboxes are rendered views migrates with no refusal and no drop flag, carries no item, and names the rendered files.
